title.narrative: International Counterproliferation Program (ICP): WMD Investigation and Operations (WIO) Course

description.narrative: The WIO Course was delivered to 20 participants including crime scene investigators, state prosecutors, state security personnel, border patrol, financial analysts, and CBRN investigative managers across multiple ministries and agencies, to include the Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the State Prosecutors Office, and the State Security Service of Georgia. The instruction provided the participants with highly specialized training on CBRN crime scene management and evidence handling techniques. The MIA Academy also received a donated equipment package designed to enhance the academys effort to develop an internal CBRN training curriculum. The curriculum will enable the MIA to generate personnel specialized in CBRN investigation operations and reduce their reliance on outside support.

title.narrative: International Counterproliferation Program (ICP): Diagnostic Functional Exercise

description.narrative: ICP conducted the Joint Maritime Operations Center (JMOC) Functional Exercise with 45 Georgian Exercise Planning Team members and participants in Batumi, Georgia on December 4-7, 2023. The agencies responsible for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) transportation and safety and security incidents were present at the event and worked through the scenarios and injects to identify gaps in both the procedural processes and information sharing policies of the interagency. The gaps identified were largely those related to information sharing and is a product of Georgian laws and policies..
